verification_report.summary: The proof correctly establishes the Vandermonde determinant identity by induction on n. The base case is valid; the row operations and first-column cofactor expansion are determinant-preserving; the geometric factorization and row factor extraction are valid even when some x_i coincide; the descending column operations correctly transform C into the Vandermonde matrix for x_2,\ldots,x_n; and the induction hypothesis yields exactly the required factorization. The statement is self-contained, no external or internal references require checking, and no critical errors or gaps were found.
